text:
maria (PM): Quick sync — we need a concise ops acceptance checklist for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) so field can sign off customers. Launch gate is next sprint.
aj (eng): TL;DR: we need explicit criteria for networking (IP ownership), upgrade/downtime windows, rollback behavior, and installer flags.
nate (SE): Customer asks are mostly: preserve existing IPs, support clustered NAT, and clear guidance when IP ranges overlap.
devon (field): +1 on IP preserve. Also customers want a non-destructive upgrade path for operator-managed tenants (no vm rebuilds).
lenka (netops): Proposed guardrails:
- installer supports `ip-preserve: true|false` at install and upgrade
- operator validates seeding CIDRs vs cluster CIDR and fails fast with actionable error
- docs with sample `ipam` mapping for common CPEs

sam (design): Can we keep error text short and link to remediation playbook? Field prefers 1-line error + link.
aj (eng): Agree. For upgrades: plan is rolling operator upgrade w/ canary tenant first, then staged rollout. Need automatic traffic drain hooks.
maria (PM): What are measurable acceptance items? I propose: 1) successful upgrade with zero IP churn for 95% of tenants in testbench, 2) rollback completes within configured window (<30m) w/ health checks green, 3) automated preflight catches misconfigured CIDRs.
qa-bot: test plan TODOs added: `upgrade_zero_churn.yaml`, `rollback_timing_sla.yaml`, `preflight_ip_conflict.yaml`.
nate (SE): Field request: a lightweight `network-dryrun` mode that validates customer topology without touching routing. Could be an installer flag `--dryrun-network`.
devon (field): That would saved multiple oncalls last quarter. Please prioritize.
lenka (netops): On customer-managed NAT — we need clear SLOs: if they manage NAT, we can't guarantee external IP continuity during scale events. Document this as a tradeoff and require a signed operational responsibility matrix.
maria (PM): Add to launch gate: signed netops responsibilities doc for managed-NAT customers.
aj (eng): Implementation notes:
```
- preflight: probe CIDRs, test route table lookups, validate KMS access if provided
- upgrade: operator will annotate pods with `rollout-stage` and perform KV cache warmup
- rollback: rely on snapshot + operator revert, require snapshot TTL >= upgrade window
```

sam (design): UX for console: display a single-pane "network health" with preflight results + one-click rerun. Low eff effort but high ROI.
devon (field): Checklist for customer signoff during POC:
1) preflight green
2) dryrun-network ok
3) sample upgrade on replica cluster
4) run failover and validate traffic flows

maria (PM): Prioritization: must-have for GA: preflight, dryrun, zero-churn upgrade path, rollback automation, console preflight view. Nice-to-have: automated IP re-mapping helpers, GUI IPAM.
nate (SE): Risks: air-gapped customers may not allow our preflight probes. Need an offline preflight package and clear manual steps.
lenka (netops): Add network-specific automated tests to CI that spin up common topologies (single-NAT, dual-NAT, edge-firewall) and assert connectivity after upgrade.
qa-bot: Added CI matrix: `topologies: [single-nat, dual-nat, provider-nat]`.
aj (eng): Resource ask: need 2 sprints from infra to add snapshot/restore hooks into operator. Can cut scope if we make rollback manual for first release.
maria (PM): Keep rollback automation in plan but mark as target for GA+1 if infra can't deliver. We still require documented manual rollback steps in docs.
devon (field): Customer comms: we'll need a 'known limitations' doc for first 3 months post-GA listing edge cases (IP overlap, CPE that rewrites source IP, legacy firewall heuristics).
sam (design): I'll draft the preflight UI and the known-limitations modal.
maria (PM): Ok action items:
- aj: sketch installer `--dryrun-network` and preflight errors (due EOD Thu)
- lenka: CI topology matrix and preflight checks (due next Tue)
- nate/devon: field test plan and signoff checklist (due next Fri)
- sam: console preflight mockups (due Mon)
- aj & infra: estimate snapshot hooks sprint (due Wed)

aj (eng): noted. I'll post a short PR with sample error texts so design can mock.
maria (PM): If we hit all must-haves, we gate GA on: preflight passes in 3/3 lab topologies, dryrun validated in 2 pilot customers, upgrade zero-churn <=95% in testbench. Otherwise ship beta.
devon (field): I'll line up two pilots (one VPC, one on-prem) to validate.
lenka (netops): Also: require KMS integration checklist for customers using CMK/HSM — otherwise we default to platform-managed keys.
maria (PM): Good point. Include KMS gating in docs and signoff.
qa-bot: Follow-ups created: #4589 preflight tests, #4590 dryrun feature, #4591 rollback doc.
aj (eng): Quick sample preflight error example for design: `ERROR: CIDR overlap detected: customer 10.0.0.0/16 collides with cluster 10.0.0.0/12 — see remediation: https://redwood/docs/private/preflight#cidr-overlap`
sam (design): Perfect. Will use that.
maria (PM): Thanks all. We'll reconvene after PRs. :thumbsup:
